outlook.statement: The management is hopeful of beginning exports soon due to the favourable announcement of anti-dumping duty by Turkey on your Company.

Global economy expected to face renewed uncertainty in 2026 due to ongoing conflict in West Asia; global growth projected to moderate to 3.1% in 2026 and improve slightly to 3.2% in 2027. India's growth outlook supported by continued investments, rapid digitalization, and favourable demographic profile. Industry outlook for FY27 remains uncertain with growth drivers intact but near-term performance constrained by demand uncertainty, input cost volatility, and geopolitical disruptions.

Certain statements in this report on Management Discussions and Analysis may be forward looking statements within the meaning of applicable securities laws and regulations. There are several factors, which would be beyond the control of the management, and as such, actual results could differ materially from those expressed or implied.

risks: International trade remained subdued due to volatile international scenario
Prices highly fluctuating
Margins constantly under strain
Iran/US war impact from February onwards
Geopolitical tensions (West Asia conflict, Iran-Israel-US conflict) impacting logistics, input costs, and operations
Disruptions in key maritime routes (Red Sea, Strait of Hormuz) increasing transit times, freight and insurance costs
Energy supply constraints (LPG imports disruption through Strait of Hormuz)
War-related surcharges adversely impacting global competitiveness
Subdued global demand, adverse tariff structure, intense price competition
Restrained Free Trade Agreements with major markets reducing export market access
Order volatility and extended receivable cycles restricting working capital
Lender risk aversion and tighter credit conditions limiting access to timely financing
Lower domestic output constraining supply, leading to increased imports and heightened price volatility
Man-made fibre and specialty yarn prices higher relative to competing manufacturing locations
Fluctuating export demand, elevated US import tariffs, inventory rationalization by global brands
Rising costs causing concern
